rootCause: Both variants reuse related art/template data.
The Renewal magic pipeline checked legacy target.magicImmune before authoritative mode normalization.
A stale 2189 magic-immunity scalar could therefore force 2190 magic damage to zero/minimum one.
fixes: Resolve combat identity by Aegis/name before numeric template fallbacks.
Export authoritative identity to the Renewal damage pipeline.
For 2190, ignore stale magicImmune/magicImmunity/immuneMagic fields; keep IgnoreMelee and IgnoreRanged.
For 2189, enforce IgnoreMagic even if stale template fields say otherwise.
At world spawn, explicitly clear all legacy magic immunity scalars for 2190 and set them for 2189.

expected.2190_magic: normal elemental magic damage after MDEF and modifiers
